object.title: UU-AAP reference implementation and validation stack
object.description: Candidate filing scope for a rights-cleared coherent software object implementing and validating UU-AAP/PoAI-related machine-readable protocol records. Abstract protocol ideas and third-party-only material are outside the claimed software object.

authors.name: TO_BE_VERIFIED_FROM_CREATIVE_CONTRIBUTION_PROVENANCE
authors.contribution_scope: Do not infer authorship merely from repository control, merge authority, or initial-proposer status.
authors.evidence_ref: Git history, PRs, issues, agreements and retained creation evidence

right_holders.name: TO_BE_VERIFIED
right_holders.contribution_scope: Filing must be narrowed to material for which the applicant can establish the exclusive-right basis.

unresolved_items: Determine exact software/deposit scope that forms one coherent program for computers.
Identify creative human authors for the selected source/deposit material.
Determine exclusive-right basis for each selected contribution.
Exclude or accurately classify inbound=outbound contributor material not assigned exclusively.
Identify third-party libraries, generated material and file-specific licenses.
Freeze a reproducible deposit package and compute its SHA-256 digest.

public_disclosure.evidence_ref: Public canonical GitHub repository and preserved release/checkpoint history

patentability.notes: The software-registration candidate is distinct from any potentially patentable technical solution. Any patent candidate requires a separate novelty/public-disclosure review.

registration_intent.rationale: Create an official registry record and reproducible deposit/evidence boundary for the rights-cleared UU-AAP software stack while preserving the distinction between software expression and abstract architecture.
